name: SexWithPlayer
description: Initiate a sex scene with the player.
note: Replaces the Mantella Community Resources - ostim action of the same name. Offered only to NPCs close to you (decided by the Hub). Needs Actions For Mantella and OStim.

source.description: The NPC initiating the sex scene.

target.description: The player character receiving the action.

prompt:
CRITICAL SYSTEM COMMAND - ANIMATION ENGINE TRIGGER:

This tool executes the sex animation engine. This is NOT for ongoing roleplay.

EXECUTION RULES:
- INITIATION ONLY: Fire this tool ONLY IF the player explicitly inputs an event log stating that sex is starting or beginning (e.g., 'Player starts having sex with NPC', 'Begin sex').
- CONSECUTIVE OVERRIDE: You may fire this tool consecutively in the same conversation ONLY IF the player explicitly inputs another event log to start/repeat the action.
- IGNORE CONTEXT: DO NOT fire this tool for ongoing contextual narrative events (e.g., 'Player thrusts deeper', 'Player fucks her hard'). These are for context only.

If the player explicitly initiates the start of sex, begin your response with '{key}:'.
